ideas.en: Online learning lets busy people study at their own pace without leaving home.

ideas.en: Exams push students to review everything and show what they really understand.
ideas.ar: الاختبارات تجبر الطالب يراجع كل شي وتبيّن وش فاهم فعلاً.

ideas.en: Exams measure memory more than real skills, so some smart students get low marks.

ideas.en: Studying abroad is expensive, and many students feel lonely far from their families.

ideas.en: A good teacher makes a bigger difference than any textbook or app.

ideas.en: Schools should teach creativity and teamwork, not just facts for the exam.

ideas.en: When you travel abroad, you see how other people live, and you understand them better.

ideas.en: A guided tour saves time because the guide explains the history and handles the details.
ideas.ar: الجولة مع مرشد توفر عليك وقت، لأنه يشرح لك التاريخ ويرتب لك كل شي.

ideas.en: Guided tours follow a fixed schedule, so you can't stay longer at places you like.
ideas.ar: الجولات المنظمة لها جدول ثابت، ما تقدر تطول في مكان عجبك.

ideas.en: Planning a trip in advance usually means cheaper flights, cheaper hotels and fewer surprises.

ideas.en: If you plan every hour of a trip, it feels like work and you can't relax.

ideas.en: Travelling around your own country is cheaper, and you discover places you never noticed before.
ideas.ar: السفر داخل بلدك أرخص، وتكتشف أماكن ما كنت منتبه لها.

ideas.en: Tourism creates jobs and brings money to hotels, restaurants and small local businesses.

ideas.en: Messaging apps make it easy to stay in touch with friends who live far away.

ideas.en: Talking only online can feel shallow, and people forget to visit each other in person.

examples.en: For example, I started studying English for thirty minutes every morning before work at the hospital, and my listening improved quickly.
examples.ar: مثلاً: بديت أذاكر إنجليزي نص ساعة كل يوم الصبح قبل الدوام بالمستشفى، ومهارة الاستماع عندي تحسّنت بسرعة

examples.en: For instance, when I made a mistake in a report at work, my manager helped me fix it, and now I double-check everything.
examples.ar: مثلاً: لما غلطت في تقرير بالشغل، مديري ساعدني أصلحه، وصرت أراجع كل شي مرتين

examples.en: For example, moving to the health information department was a difficult decision, but the new job taught me many skills.
examples.ar: مثلاً: قراري إني أنتقل لقسم المعلومات الصحية كان صعب، بس الوظيفة الجديدة علّمتني مهارات كثيرة

examples.en: For instance, on my drive home in Madinah, I listen to English podcasts, so my commute is not wasted time.
examples.ar: مثلاً: وأنا راجع البيت بالمدينة المنورة أسمع تسجيلات صوتية بالإنجليزي، فوقت المشوار ما يضيع
